summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Brenmiller Energy Ltd., a foreign private issuer, furnishing the notice, proxy statement, and proxy card for its annual and special general meeting scheduled for July 29, 2026. The agenda includes routine matters: re-appointment of auditors, re-election of Class III directors, a company name change, and approval of compensation for the chairman and CEO. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is present. This is an ordinary shareholder meeting filing with no event-driven trigger.
